name: Vapi support case review in Telbox

nodes.name: Read case reference
nodes.notes: Only the fixed case reference and review UUID are needed.

nodes.name: Find my Telbox inbox
nodes.notes: Choose the same approved MCP OAuth2 credential on both Telbox nodes. Resolves the connected account’s existing Notes to Self without reading messages or creating a conversation.

nodes.name: Use my existing inbox
nodes.notes: Stops if the inbox needs setup or discovery results conflict. Keeps the original validated text and logical event ID.

nodes.name: Request Telbox message approval
nodes.notes: Select the same approved MCP OAuth2 credential as inbox discovery, with messages:write. No automatic node retries. A timeout has an unknown outcome. Token refresh may retry rejected 401 requests inside the host transport; real lifecycle qualification is pending.

nodes.name: Record proposal outcome only
nodes.notes: Terminal output. Do not connect business actions here: owner approval of this message is not approval of an external action, and native delivery/reply continuation have not been verified.
